story.headline1: This is how a digital transformation begins.
story.headline2: One conversation. Four services. One system.
svc.web.title:
Website
Creation
svc.web.desc: We don't just create websites. We build digital experiences that represent your brand, build trust and are ready to evolve with your business.
svc.web.b1d: A fast, fluid experience, with optimized code and no bloat that slows down loading.
svc.web.b2d: Every page, section and interaction has a purpose: moving the visitor to the next step.
svc.web.b3d: Architecture ready for new pages, features, integrations and the business's next stages.
svc.web.p1desc: For businesses starting their digital presence.
svc.web.p2desc: For businesses that need a stronger digital platform.
svc.web.p3desc: For companies requiring custom digital solutions.
svc.bot.title:
Intelligent
Chatbots
svc.bot.desc: Your business responding in seconds, 24 hours a day — with answers that understand context and keep your brand's tone. We automate conversations to serve, qualify and route customers without making the experience feel robotic.
svc.bot.b1d: Support available at any time, with fast answers to questions and requests.
svc.bot.b2d: Understands each contact's profile and intent, filtering opportunities before they reach your team.
svc.bot.b3d: Connects WhatsApp, CRM, scheduling and other systems to turn conversations into actions.
svc.bot.p1desc: Automated answers for the most common questions.
svc.bot.p2desc: For businesses with real conversation volume every day.
svc.bot.p3desc: For operations that need end-to-end automation.
svc.ads.title:
Paid
Traffic
svc.ads.desc: Put your business in front of the right people, at the right time. We create and optimize paid traffic campaigns with strategy, data and focus on the result that truly matters to the business.
svc.ads.b1d: Reach audiences with the highest potential for interest and conversion.
svc.ads.b2d: We analyze campaigns, creatives and results to find improvement opportunities continuously.
svc.ads.b3d: We track investment, cost per acquisition, conversions and return — not just clicks and likes.
svc.ads.p1desc: First campaigns with the right structure.
svc.ads.p2desc: For businesses ready to scale acquisition.
svc.ads.p3desc: For operations with significant media investment.
svc.mkt.title: Marketing
svc.mkt.desc: Build a brand that communicates your business's value before the first conversation. We combine strategy, identity and content to create a consistent, relevant digital presence that builds trust.
svc.mkt.b1d: A consistent brand across every touchpoint with your audience.
svc.mkt.b2d: Content created to communicate, position and bring your brand closer to the right people.
svc.mkt.b3d: A presence that communicates professionalism, differentiates your business and strengthens perceived value.
svc.mkt.p1desc: Basic visual organization of the brand.
svc.mkt.p3desc: Marketing as a system, not a one-off action.
about.statement: We don't just build websites. We build the digital foundation that makes your business evolve.
about.p1: Odysen exists to transform businesses through technology, creating digital operations that are more efficient, connected and ready to grow. We combine technology, design, automation, marketing and strategy into a single operation.
about.p2: We act as long-term partners, not one-off suppliers. Every decision is made with the business's next step in mind, not just the immediate problem.
ambition.statement: Precision to build. Execution to deliver. Evolution to keep going.
ambition.p1: To build a technology company that helps businesses evolve continuously. We combine engineering, artificial intelligence, automation, design and digital growth to turn real needs into solutions that create value. We don't believe in transformation as a project with an end date. We believe in building, measuring, learning and evolving continuously.
ambition.p2: We measure impact, not just deliverables. Every project advances in clear stages, with decisions guided by data, context and hands-on experience.
work.title: We don't just talk about digital transformation. We build it.
process.title: The process
process.s1d: Understand the business, its goals, its audience and where the biggest opportunities are.
process.s2d: Turn needs into a clear strategy, prioritizing what can generate the most impact.
process.s3d: Define the experience, technology and structure that best serve the goal.
process.s4d: Develop and integrate every solution with quality, performance and scalability.
process.s5d: Put the solution into operation with monitoring and measurement from day one.
process.s6d: Analyze results, learn from the data and improve continuously.
faq.a1: We start by understanding where the business is today, its goals and the challenges that need to be solved. From there, we define the most suitable combination of solutions for the project — no unnecessary packages.
faq.q2: How long does a project take?
faq.a2: The timeline depends on the scope, complexity and integrations involved. Simpler projects can be completed in a few weeks, while more complex solutions require more planning, development and validation stages. We define the schedule before the project begins.
faq.q3: Does Odysen integrate with existing systems?
faq.a3: Yes. We integrate our solutions with the systems and tools the business already uses, such as CRMs, ERPs, payment platforms, WhatsApp, scheduling and automation tools. We evaluate each integration according to the project's needs and technical feasibility.
faq.q4: Are the services customized for each business?
faq.a4: Yes. We don't work with a one-size-fits-all solution. We understand each business's moment, goals and needs to define the scope and the solutions that truly make sense for the project.
faq.q5: Can I hire just one service?
faq.a5: Yes. You can hire only the solution your business needs today. When it makes sense, we can connect that service to other Odysen solutions to support the business's next stages.
faq.q6: What happens after the project is launched?
faq.a6: Launch doesn't have to be the end of the project. Every project includes a technical warranty period after delivery. After that, new improvements and changes can be hired on demand or through a continuous evolution plan.
